title: M3-3 final directive: AUD-06 simulation suite and AUD-07 threshold interpretation
objective: Implement and execute the predeclared statistical simulation suite (SIM-01 to SIM-18) exercising Arbit's actual DvP estimators and the complete development-selection-validation-decision procedure against known data-generating processes, with uncertainty validation; reproduce and correct the interpretation of the 1.8-point Phase C threshold and run a separately versioned descriptive threshold sensitivity, without changing any frozen threshold, method or the 2026 confirmation.

review.summary: AUD-06 had no simulation suite; AUD-07's derivation (config/dvp/sitstart.json practicalMinimumDerivation) uses 0.5+asin(rho)/pi with D/ST B00's development Spearman 0.1448. Read the actual estimator, selection and decision code to exercise it unchanged: walkforward (prepare, fit_fold, walk, metrics, decide), shadow (scheduled_targets, walk_targets with extra hooks, forecast_only, attach_labels), explore (make_extra, make_opportunity_extra), lab (adjust, groups, reml_components, bootstrap_components), reliability (halves, split_half), opportunity.reliability, the frozen dvp.py _select, decisions (units, pairs, metrics, decide), league (decide, summarize). Pilot: about 5.7 s per full-procedure repetition on 8 workers.

plan.summary: 1) Declare and push config/dvp/simulation-v1.json (scenarios SIM-01..18, DGP, truth, reps, streams, measurements, acceptance A1-A8, inconclusive rule, budget) and config/dvp/threshold-sensitivity-v1.json before running. 2) Generator arbit_model.dvp.simulate in the real schemas with tests. 3) Runner (E1, E2, E3, U; resumable; spawned workers) and summarizer (acceptance with Monte Carlo intervals, plots). 4) Pilot against the budget, then the full suite. 5) AUD-07 script: reproduce the derivation, Pearson/Spearman, non-uniqueness on the actual forecasts, the descriptive grid from committed receipts. 6) Reports, register closure, records.

implementation.summary: simulate.py (Scenario, SCENARIOS, generate with traits, persistence, abrupt/drift, exposure, MCAR/MNAR, shocks, heavy tails, tiers, volume/efficiency channels, oracle; known_difference); dvp_simulate.py (E1 estimator recovery, E2 complete procedure with every frozen and exploratory variant and Phase C, E3 league with all-week, changed-week and naive bootstraps and a separate truth, U bootstrap coverage; SeedSequence streams; resumable JSONL; frozen _select from git); dvp_simulate_summary.py (measurements, acceptance A1-A8 with the declared two-sided A8 check plus a labelled one-sided supplement, plots via arbit_model.dvp.svg); dvp_thresholds.py (D1, D2). Full suite ran at cc25e2c (33,100 repetitions, 0 failed); summary at 901da3d; thresholds at e65dcea.

journal.note: Scope extended by hand with scripts/model/dvp_simulate_summary.py (the suite's summarizer, split from the runner).
